title: SPAN: Benchmarking and Improving Cross-Calendar Temporal Reasoning of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy of LLMs on cross-calendar temporal reasoning tasks in two directions: 'Gregorian-to-Others' versus 'Others-to-Gregorian' (involving Chinese Lunar, Islamic, Hebrew, Shaka, and Persian calendars) to measure 'Calendar Asymmetry Bias', which reveals an over-reliance on the Western-centric Gregorian system.
